notes.text: Available in cPanel 116 and later; operates on the selected cPanel account. Omitted optional inputs, including null, retain server behavior; explicit false, zero and empty strings remain distinct. Literal dotted services.* wire names are form or query keys, not nested request objects.

Changes the selected cPanel account's password from cPanel 116. The current and new passwords are sensitive form inputs. enablemysql defaults to 0; enabledigest has no pinned default. Digest Authentication is documented for the listed Windows clients accessing Web Disk over an unencrypted connection. The source declares no rollback.
Returns a nullable object without pinned fields. Preserve opaque object fields and explicit null; an absent data member is a payload mismatch.

evidence.note: Pinned /Users/change_password declares x-readonly=false. Use form POST for the selected-account mutation; password fields stay sensitive. Preserve pinned parameter requiredness, scalar types and literal dotted field names.
